Our company's annual health fair will be taking place next week.
I'm excited to tell you that this year you'll be able to meet individually with a nutritionist to ask questions about your diet and get a personal nutrition plan.
What an opportunity!
How could you miss this?
I hope everyone will have time to participate.
Oh, and we're asking that you sign up ahead of time on the sheet posted in the break room.
We need to know how many of you will be attending.
